comment: KOTOR III (fan) Nar Shaddaa landing pad. Kiri, an old refugee, remembers a Mandalorian asking about old routes. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: Mind the crates, dear. Everything I own is packed in them. Are you lost, or only new here? On this pad the two look much the same.
Then you want the Mandalorian. Scarred armour, quiet voice. She came through here asking about the old routes too, and about a ship that never came home.
Long enough to stop counting. They keep promising a transport. I keep my crates tied up anyway, in case one day somebody means it.
She keeps to the far end of the pad, watching the ships land. If you want more than an old woman's guess, the Duros broker sells names.
Everyone here is dangerous, dear. But she gave half her ration bar to my neighbour's boy and asked for nothing back. That counts with me.

replies.text: I am looking for someone who knows the old routes past the charts.
How long have you been waiting here?
I hope it comes soon. Have you seen anyone asking about routes past the charts?
Then where would I find her?
